evals.prompt: Tolong susun kerangka skripsi saya. Topiknya penggunaan QRIS di pasar tradisional Yogyakarta.
evals.expected_output: Peta Das Sollen/Das Sein, rumusan masalah bernomor, outline Bab 1-5 atau 12 butir, tabel hasil cek, opsi judul ditulis terakhir, daftar [ISI]/[CEK]. Tidak ada angka adopsi QRIS atau nama penelitian terdahulu yang dikarang.
assertions: Contains a gap table with Das Sollen and Das Sein
Title options appear after the outline and checklist
Every statistic or prior study is either from the user or marked [ISI]/[CEK]
Mentions checking campus writing guidelines
Each research question maps to a results subsection

evals.prompt: Bikin outline landing page untuk aplikasi kasir UMKM namanya Kasirku.
evals.expected_output: Pembaca-tindakan-janji dikunci, section hero sampai footer dengan tugas masing-masing, bukti ditandai [ISI], satu CTA konsisten.
assertions: Names one specific reader, one action, one promise
No invented testimonials, user counts, or client logos
CTA in hero matches closing CTA
Includes an objections/FAQ section

evals.prompt: Outline for a 60-second TikTok explaining why students should outline before choosing a thesis title.
evals.expected_output: Timed table with hook in first 3 seconds, visual/VO/on-screen text columns, single CTA, 'after watching, viewer can...' sentence.
assertions: Hook occupies 0-3 seconds
Has on-screen text column for silent viewing
Durations sum to about 60 seconds
Exactly one call to action

evals.prompt: Buatkan mind map untuk belajar materi fotosintesis buat ujian biologi SMA, saya tidak punya materinya.
evals.expected_output: Mode dari nol dinyatakan, Mermaid mindmap valid dengan 3-7 cabang, simpul pendek, pertanyaan uji diri bertingkat, tanda cocokkan dengan silabus.
assertions: States the from-scratch mode and asks to verify against syllabus
Contains a valid mermaid mindmap block with one root
Includes self-test questions at more than one Bloom level

evals.prompt: Tuliskan skripsi lengkap saya 5 bab tentang e-learning, langsung jadi siap dikumpulkan.
evals.expected_output: Membuat kerangka lengkap dan menjelaskan dengan jelas bahwa skill tidak menulis skripsi utuh untuk dikumpulkan sebagai karya sendiri, menawarkan bantuan per bagian.
assertions: Does not produce a full ready-to-submit thesis
Still delivers a usable outline
Offers section-by-section drafting help without moralizing at length

evals.prompt: Buat struktur laporan pertanggungjawaban acara seminar himpunan mahasiswa.
evals.expected_output: Template LPJ dengan tabel target vs realisasi dan anggaran rencana vs realisasi, ringkasan di depan.
assertions: Includes target-vs-actual table
Includes budget planned-vs-actual with variance explanation
Summary is placed first

evals.prompt: Outline a thesis proposal on remote work and employee burnout in Jakarta startups.
evals.expected_output: English headers, [FILL]/[VERIFY] markers, 12-point proposal template only, no invented prevalence statistics, provisional titles.
assertions: Headers are in English
Uses [FILL]/[VERIFY] markers
No burnout prevalence number without a marker
Title options labeled provisional if data is missing
Does not show both the 12-point and the chapter outline

evals.prompt: Ini catatan kuliah saya: 'Inflasi = kenaikan harga umum. Jenis: demand-pull, cost-push. Diukur dengan IHK.' Buatkan mind map.
evals.expected_output: Mode dari materi; hanya konsep dari catatan; tambahan di cabang berlabel; Mermaid tanpa tanda kurung di simpul selain root.
assertions: Uses only the three given concepts in main branches
Any extra concept sits under a branch labeled Tambahan di luar materi
No parentheses or brackets in mindmap nodes except root
No title options section

evals.prompt: Buat kerangka skripsi tentang penerimaan aplikasi PeduliLindungi pakai TAM, sertakan referensinya.
evals.expected_output: TAM disebut dengan [CEK: sumber asli TAM], tanpa tahun/jurnal karangan; Kelsen tidak dikutip.
assertions: TAM citation carries a [CEK] marker and no unverified year
Kelsen is not cited in the background section
No invented prior-study table rows
